hints.title: Pivot Decomposition
hints.text: Any valid increasing path passing through coordinates[k] consists of points strictly dominated by coordinates[k], followed by coordinates[k] itself, followed by points strictly dominating coordinates[k].

hints.title: Russian Doll Envelope Reduction
hints.text: To find the longest strictly increasing 2D chain, sort points by x ascending and y descending. Sorting y descending prevents selecting multiple points with identical x coordinates.

hints.title: Binary Search Patience Sorting
hints.text: Run standard 1D longest increasing chain on the y coordinates using binary search (patience sorting) for both the left and right subsets independently.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n) and patience sorting binary searches take O(n log n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard O(n^2) DP or DAG traversal times out for n up to 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for partitioned arrays and tails array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decomposes around pivot coordinates[k] and reduces to 2D LIS with x-asc, y-desc sorting.
